introHeading: The Mirror X for Queens' corporate events
introParas: Long Island City has become one of the busiest corporate event corridors in the borough — company holiday parties and product launches in newer buildings with real ceiling height and a designed interior, the kind of room where our gold-framed mirror can look a little out of place. The Mirror X is the fit for that space: six feet of frameless glass, the same interactive touchscreen and DSLR photography as our original mirror, in a profile that reads modern instead of ornate.

We built the Mirror X around corporate work, and it is the booth we recommend for Queens trade shows, product launches and company parties where your brand needs to show up on the start screen and every print. Custom overlays, a logo lockup print template and opt-in data capture are all available, built from your brand assets after you book. Its unlimited sessions and unlimited 4x6 prints keep a booth running all night at a big company event without turning into a bottleneck.

Space and power needs match our other mirror booth — 10ft x 10ft optimal, 8ft x 8ft minimum with 7.5ft of ceiling clearance for a tighter floor, one standard 110V outlet within 15 feet. Setup takes about 20 minutes and we arrive a full hour before your start time. Queens is a standard service area with no surprise fees, whether your venue is in Long Island City, Astoria or Forest Hills — travel is quoted from your venue ZIP before you book.

faqHeading: Mirror X Photo Booth in Queens — FAQ

faqs.q: Is the Mirror X a good fit for a Long Island City corporate event?
faqs.a: Yes — it is the booth we place most often in LIC's newer office and event spaces, where the frameless glass profile matches the room's own design better than our gold-framed mirror does.

faqs.q: Can we brand the Mirror X for our company's Queens event?
faqs.a: Yes — a branded start screen, custom overlays, a print template with your logo lockup, and opt-in data capture are all available, built from your brand assets after you book.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the Mirror X and the gold-framed mirror booth for a Queens event?
faqs.a: Same touchscreen, DSLR photos and unlimited prints on both. Most of our Queens weddings and Sweet Sixteens choose the classic gold-framed mirror; most corporate parties and trade shows in Long Island City choose the Mirror X for its cleaner profile.

faqs.q: How much space does the Mirror X need?
faqs.a: 10ft x 10ft optimal, 8ft x 8ft minimum with 7.5ft of ceiling clearance for a tighter floor, and one standard 110V outlet within 15 feet.

faqs.q: Is there a travel fee to bring the Mirror X to Queens?
faqs.a: Queens is a standard service area with no surprise fees. We quote travel from your venue ZIP code before you book.
Yes. A trained attendant runs the Mirror X for your full Queens booking — setup, guiding guests through the touchscreen, and breakdown afterward.

faqs.q: Do you carry insurance and can you provide a COI for a Queens venue?
faqs.a: Yes. We carry a $3 million insurance policy. If your Queens venue needs a certificate of insurance naming them as additionally insured, reply to your booking confirmation with their contact email and we will send it over.

faqs.q: Can the Mirror X keep up with a large trade show or company party crowd?
faqs.a: Yes. Every rental includes unlimited sessions and unlimited 4x6 prints all night, and if your guest count is especially large we can talk through pairing it with a second station or a roaming attendant.
